config.noise_policy: CPU float32 torch.randn([71,24,1]) per local Generator seed; same four tensors reused across all timesteps, models, training seeds and interventions
config.scoring: FP32 forward; FP64 MSE and RMS reductions; no clipping; only supervised denoising, no DDIM
config.aggregation: Four noise repeats within each day, then 71 days within model; retain each t and training seed; sample SD over three training seeds

metrics.noise_mse: mean over 24 hours of squared predicted minus injected noise
metrics.delta_mse: intervention noise MSE minus normal lambda=1 MSE
metrics.output_change_rms: RMS of intervention prediction minus normal prediction
metrics.first_update_rms: RMS of H1-H0; repeated across lambdas
metrics.input_state_change_rms: RMS of H_lambda-H1; BASE zero (no second Core)
metrics.final_state_change_rms: RMS of intervention final state minus normal final state

interpretation: Supervised denoiser MSE, not forecasting scores; mean noises within day then days within model; SD across three training seeds.
